title: A Museum Brochure
text:
Ania found a brochure about a museum in the hotel lobby. The brochure was blue and had many colourful pictures. It said the museum is open every day from nine in the morning to five in the afternoon.

The brochure also included a map of the city. The museum costs five euros for adults, but children can enter for free. Ania decided to visit the museum the next day.

questions.text: Where did Ania find the brochure?
How much does the museum cost for adults?
Why did Ania probably take the brochure?
options: She wanted to learn about the museum
She wanted to write a letter

questions.text: Why might a family with young children choose this museum?
options: Because children can enter for free
Because the hotel is far away

vocabulary.definition: a small booklet with information and pictures
a large room at the entrance of a building
a drawing that shows the streets and places of an area

paragraph_translations: Ania znalazła ulotkę o muzeum w holu hotelu. Ulotka była niebieska i miała wiele kolorowych zdjęć. Pisało w niej, że muzeum jest otwarte codziennie od dziewiątej rano do piątej po południu.
Ulotka zawierała także mapę miasta. Bilet do muzeum dla dorosłych kosztuje pięć euro, ale dzieci mogą wejść za darmo. Ania postanowiła odwiedzić muzeum następnego dnia.
